blind.description: A thick, medieval-style arched wooden door leaf made of vertical planks with light grey weathered wood grain. It features dark forged iron hardware on both faces, including two horizontal strap hinges with hinge knuckles on one edge, an iron ring handle/knocker on the latch side, and an arched row of rounded iron studs/rivets around the top curved perimeter. All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and continuous.
blind.from_above: A rounded thick rectangular strip oriented horizontally, showing the curved top edge of the door with protruding studs and hinge hardware on both sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 to 5 feet tall (reaching just below the top of the cylinder/head of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.49x off the catalog (3.6 x 1.2 ft)
